answer: In the prism ledger, each orchard shard commits stake under quadratic slashing: a Sybil cluster attacking s validators incurs C(s)=k s^2.1 capital lockup plus 0.4 s^2 slashed value, while max extractable value V(s)=a s. Since marginal cost dC/ds=(2.1k+0.8s)s exceeds V(s) once s surpasses a/(2.1k+0.8s), the river of consensus flow is protected; economic threshold holds when bonded stake exceeds 3.2 billion.
